facts.text: The resort overlooks a secluded bay on the Son Tra Peninsula.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort overlooks a secluded bay on the Son Tra Peninsula

facts.text: The resort is about 30 minutes by car from Danang International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Only 30 minutes by car from Danang International Airport (DAD)

facts.text: The resort is set on its own private bay.
facts.excerpt: Retreat into a world of unspoiled nature, set on our private bay

facts.text: The resort is spread across the lush hills of the Son Tra Peninsula nature reserve down to the sandy shores of the East Sea.
facts.excerpt: Scattered amongst the lush hills of the Son Tra Peninsula nature reserve and down to the sandy shores of the East Sea

facts.text: The resort has a private beach that leads to the clear waters of a sheltered bay.
facts.excerpt: the lounger-dotted private beach, which leads to the clear waters of a sheltered bay

facts.text: The rooms are decorated in a Modern Vietnamese style, with spindled wooden pillars that evoke traditional temple architecture.
facts.excerpt: the accommodations are awash in chic Modern Vietnamese style; think spindled wooden pillars that evoke traditional temple architecture

facts.text: Room interiors have Vietnamese-inspired decor and lead to spacious balconies with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Interiors draped in Vietnamese-inspired decor lead to spacious balconies and dramatic ocean vistas.

facts.text: The Club Penthouse and Villa Collection has expansive indoor and outdoor spaces and private pools.
facts.excerpt: featuring lavish spaces with expansive indoor and outdoor areas, authentic design touches, and private pools

facts.text: The forests surrounding the resort are home to unique flora and fauna.
facts.excerpt: the surrounding forests are home to unique flora and fauna

facts.text: Guests can take jungle walks or join the resort's nature expert on a Wildlife Expedition.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy walks in the jungle or join our Nature expert on a Wildlife Expedition.

facts.text: The resort has an 800-year-old banyan tree.
facts.excerpt: Our 800-year-old Banyan Tree

facts.text: The resort's spa is Mi Sol Spa.
facts.excerpt: soothe your body and soul at Mi Sol Spa

facts.text: La Maison 1888 is a Michelin-starred French restaurant led by Michelin chef Christian Le Squer.
facts.excerpt: Step in from the rainforest to Paris with Michelin chef Christian Le Squer. La Maison 1888 remains Central Vietnam's only Michelin starred restaurant, retaining its star since 2024.

facts.text: Citron has open-air dining booths shaped like traditional non la hats.
facts.excerpt: Uniquely designed open air dining booths shaped like traditional non la hats are a perennial favourite.

facts.text: The resort has the Planet Trekkers kids' club.
facts.excerpt: Drop the little ones off at the Planet Trekkers kids’ club

facts.text: Hoi An, a UNESCO Heritage Site, is about a 40-minute drive from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Hoi An is a UNESCO Heritage Site and the cultural jewel of central Vietnam is any easy 40-minute drive from the resort.

facts.text: Linh Ung Pagoda is on the Son Tra Peninsula, on the way to the resort.
facts.excerpt: Located on the Son Tra Peninsula en route to the resort, Linh Ung Pagoda offers sweeping views of the sea and the surrounding areas.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the resort.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort.

facts.text: The minimum check-in age is 18.
facts.excerpt: **Minimum check-in age:** 18

facts.text: The resort feels far removed from the real world despite being 30 minutes from the airport.
facts.excerpt: Though just 30 minutes from the Da Nang airport, InterContinental’s flagship Vietnam property feels much farther away from the “real world.”

facts.text: The architecture marries local heritage with world-class design.
facts.excerpt: creative architecture that marries local heritage with world-class design
